text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The applause continued without end even after the award ceremony.
With a bright smile, Tap Dance City answered the roaring cheers for as long as she could.

text_block_list.name: Tap's Friends
text_block_list.text: Yaaaay!! Congrats, Tap~!

text_block_list.name: French Madame
text_block_list.text:
C'est magnifique!
Tap Dance City!
Félicitations! Ah, con-gra-tula-tions?

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Oui! Congrats, congrats!
You did it, Tap~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Haha, look at you two getting along so well!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tap Dance City's friend and a French woman
put their arms around each other's shoulders to celebrate the win.
I recall the story I heard from them yesterday after meeting up--

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I was running around asking about traffic info.
And the locals were super helpful~.
They even brought over someone who spoke Japanese for me.

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text: When I asked why they're being so kind to us... they said it's because they want foreign Umamusume to give the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe everything they've got, too.

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
They said that's the kind of race they want to see.
And that's why they want to help.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I see... The 'Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe'
is a romantic dream for them as well, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired High School Girl
text_block_list.text:
"I don't really get all the complicated stuff~,
but... we totally felt a connection, right~?!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
(Connections... Thanks to them, today I was able
to run my own race. In that case—)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... no, Navigator.
I have a proposition.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: I want to welcome a new crewmate aboard our ship!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Comrades from France, and all across the globe,
chasing an endless dream!
choice_data_list: Then we'll have to build an even bigger castle!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yes! That's the spirit!
As expected of our navigator!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, Tap Dance City spread both arms wide toward the stands.
In a booming voice that shook the grandstand, she called out to the audience.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Everyone!
All of you who have been captivated by the romance of the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Won't you chase that romantic dream
together with me!?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
All who come are more than welcome!
With our hearts dancing with dreams, let us travel the world together!
